blocks.text: Day 12 · An early walk on the Liana Chica trail to Sacha’s canopy walkway, a free-standing suspension bridge 36 m high and 275 m long, one of only a few in the world, for a bird’s-eye view of the rainforest; continue on the Liana Grande and Higuerón trails through terra firme and flooded forest among giant kapok and fig trees, learning about medicinal plants. In the afternoon, a walk along the Napo or the Leoncillo trail, in search of black spider monkeys. (B, L, D)

paragraphs.text: Day 11 · A late-morning flight to Coca (30 minutes), a box lunch in town, then 2 hours by motorised canoe down the Napo River, a 30-minute walk through the forest and a paddle across Lake Pilchicocha to Sacha Lodge (arrival around 15:30–16:00). Swim in the lake, visit the butterfly house and, after dinner, take a night walk or a canoe ride to spot caimans. (B, L, D)

paragraphs.text: Days 11–15    Four days at Sacha Lodge · return to Quito · departure

Day 13 · The Lagartococha trail and Indigenous traditions; a canoe ride through a swamp with caimans and capybaras; piranha fishing. In the afternoon, a silent canoe ride through the flooded forest among squirrel, capuchin and howler monkeys, then a wooden tower of about 40 m built around a giant kapok tree, with sunset over Mount Sumaco and a magical night canoe ride back. (B, L, D)
